datasets.name: ds_fac
queryLines:
SELECT facility_id, state, facility_type, location_trust, CASE location_trust WHEN 'verified' THEN 'Verified on the map' WHEN 'verified_osm' THEN 'Verified (OpenStreetMap)'
  WHEN 'probable' THEN 'Probable' WHEN 'approximate_pin' THEN 'Only the PIN-code centre' ELSE 'Unverified' END AS location_label, facility_trust,
        CASE WHEN merge_suspect_score >= 2 THEN 'May mix several hospitals' WHEN merge_suspect_score >= 1 THEN 'Watch' ELSE 'Looks like one hospital' END AS merge_label,
        CASE WHEN merge_suspect_score >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_merge,
        CASE WHEN location_trust IN ('unverified', 'approximate_pin') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS loc_weak,
        CASE WHEN location_trust IN ('verified', 'verified_osm', 'probable') AND merge_suspect_score < 2 AND facility_trust >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS passes
      FROM workspace.facility_finder.facilities_serving

datasets.name: ds_funnel
queryLines:
WITH s AS (SELECT s.facility_id, s.state, s.facility_type, s.location_trust, s.merge_suspect_score, s.facility_trust,
          (st.facility_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_strong
        FROM workspace.facility_finder.facilities_serving s LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT facility_id FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims WHERE level = 'Strong') st ON s.facility_id = st.facility_id)
      SELECT '1 All records' AS stage, state, facility_type, facility_id FROM s
      UNION ALL SELECT '2 Position checked', state, facility_type, facility_id FROM s WHERE location_trust IN ('verified', 'verified_osm', 'probable')
      UNION ALL SELECT '3 Not a suspected merge', state, facility_type, facility_id FROM s WHERE location_trust IN ('verified', 'verified_osm', 'probable') AND merge_suspect_score < 2
      UNION ALL SELECT '4 Trust score 60+', state, facility_type, facility_id FROM s WHERE location_trust IN ('verified', 'verified_osm', 'probable') AND merge_suspect_score < 2 AND facility_trust >= 60
      UNION ALL SELECT '5 Has a Strong claim', state, facility_type, facility_id FROM s WHERE location_trust IN ('verified', 'verified_osm', 'probable') AND merge_suspect_score < 2 AND facility_trust >= 60 AND has_strong

datasets.name: ds_examples
queryLines:
WITH st AS (
        SELECT facility_id, service, get(snippets, 0).text AS quote, regexp_extract(get(cite_urls, 0).url, 'https?://([^/]+)', 1) AS source_site,
               row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY facility_id ORDER BY claim_strength DESC) AS k
        FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims WHERE level = 'Strong' AND facility_merge_suspect AND NOT coalesce(get(cite_urls, 0).names_facility_in_url, false))
      SELECT s.name, s.city AS listed_city, s.state AS state_on_map, s.merge_suspect_score AS merge_red_flags, s.facility_trust,
             st.service AS strong_claim, st.quote, st.source_site
      FROM workspace.facility_finder.facilities_serving s JOIN st ON s.facility_id = st.facility_id AND st.k = 1
      WHERE s.merge_suspect_score >= 3 AND s.location_trust = 'unverified' AND st.quote IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY s.n_claims DESC LIMIT 8

datasets.name: ds_trace
queryLines:
SELECT c.service, s.facility_id, s.name, s.city, s.state, s.district, s.lat, s.lon, c.level, c.claim_strength,
       s.location_trust, s.location_trust_score, s.merge_suspect_score, s.facility_trust,
       CASE s.location_trust WHEN 'verified' THEN 'Verified on the map' WHEN 'verified_osm' THEN 'Verified (OpenStreetMap)'
            WHEN 'probable' THEN 'Probable' WHEN 'approximate_pin' THEN 'Only the PIN-code centre' ELSE 'Unverified' END AS location_label,
       (c.level IN ('Strong', 'Moderate')) AS ok_claim,
       (s.location_trust IN ('verified', 'verified_osm', 'probable')) AS ok_loc,
       (s.merge_suspect_score < 2) AS ok_merge,
       (s.facility_trust >= 60) AS ok_trust,
       get(c.snippets, 0).text AS quote,
       regexp_extract(get(c.cite_urls, 0).url, 'https?://([^/]+)', 1) AS source_site,
       CASE WHEN get(c.cite_urls, 0).names_facility_in_url THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS source_names_facility
FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims c JOIN workspace.facility_finder.facilities_serving s ON c.facility_id = s.facility_id

datasets.name: ds_trace_funnel
queryLines:
WITH b AS (
SELECT c.service, s.facility_id, s.name, s.city, s.state, s.district, s.lat, s.lon, c.level, c.claim_strength,
       s.location_trust, s.location_trust_score, s.merge_suspect_score, s.facility_trust,
       CASE s.location_trust WHEN 'verified' THEN 'Verified on the map' WHEN 'verified_osm' THEN 'Verified (OpenStreetMap)'
            WHEN 'probable' THEN 'Probable' WHEN 'approximate_pin' THEN 'Only the PIN-code centre' ELSE 'Unverified' END AS location_label,
       (c.level IN ('Strong', 'Moderate')) AS ok_claim,
       (s.location_trust IN ('verified', 'verified_osm', 'probable')) AS ok_loc,
       (s.merge_suspect_score < 2) AS ok_merge,
       (s.facility_trust >= 60) AS ok_trust,
       get(c.snippets, 0).text AS quote,
       regexp_extract(get(c.cite_urls, 0).url, 'https?://([^/]+)', 1) AS source_site,
       CASE WHEN get(c.cite_urls, 0).names_facility_in_url THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS source_names_facility
FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims c JOIN workspace.facility_finder.facilities_serving s ON c.facility_id = s.facility_id
)
      SELECT '1 Claims this service' AS stage, service, state, facility_id FROM b
      UNION ALL SELECT '2 Evidence Strong or Moderate', service, state, facility_id FROM b WHERE ok_claim
      UNION ALL SELECT '3 Position checked', service, state, facility_id FROM b WHERE ok_claim AND ok_loc
      UNION ALL SELECT '4 Not a suspected merge', service, state, facility_id FROM b WHERE ok_claim AND ok_loc AND ok_merge
      UNION ALL SELECT '5 Trust score 60+', service, state, facility_id FROM b WHERE ok_claim AND ok_loc AND ok_merge AND ok_trust

datasets.name: ds_map
queryLines:
WITH b AS (
SELECT c.service, s.facility_id, s.name, s.city, s.state, s.district, s.lat, s.lon, c.level, c.claim_strength,
       s.location_trust, s.location_trust_score, s.merge_suspect_score, s.facility_trust,
       CASE s.location_trust WHEN 'verified' THEN 'Verified on the map' WHEN 'verified_osm' THEN 'Verified (OpenStreetMap)'
            WHEN 'probable' THEN 'Probable' WHEN 'approximate_pin' THEN 'Only the PIN-code centre' ELSE 'Unverified' END AS location_label,
       (c.level IN ('Strong', 'Moderate')) AS ok_claim,
       (s.location_trust IN ('verified', 'verified_osm', 'probable')) AS ok_loc,
       (s.merge_suspect_score < 2) AS ok_merge,
       (s.facility_trust >= 60) AS ok_trust,
       get(c.snippets, 0).text AS quote,
       regexp_extract(get(c.cite_urls, 0).url, 'https?://([^/]+)', 1) AS source_site,
       CASE WHEN get(c.cite_urls, 0).names_facility_in_url THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS source_names_facility
FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims c JOIN workspace.facility_finder.facilities_serving s ON c.facility_id = s.facility_id
)
      SELECT service, state, name, lat, lon,
             CASE WHEN ok_claim AND ok_loc AND ok_merge AND ok_trust THEN 'Passes all checks' WHEN ok_claim THEN 'Claim ok, but a check failed' ELSE 'Weak or contradicted' END AS verdict
      FROM b WHERE lat IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: ds_top
queryLines:
WITH b AS (
SELECT c.service, s.facility_id, s.name, s.city, s.state, s.district, s.lat, s.lon, c.level, c.claim_strength,
       s.location_trust, s.location_trust_score, s.merge_suspect_score, s.facility_trust,
       CASE s.location_trust WHEN 'verified' THEN 'Verified on the map' WHEN 'verified_osm' THEN 'Verified (OpenStreetMap)'
            WHEN 'probable' THEN 'Probable' WHEN 'approximate_pin' THEN 'Only the PIN-code centre' ELSE 'Unverified' END AS location_label,
       (c.level IN ('Strong', 'Moderate')) AS ok_claim,
       (s.location_trust IN ('verified', 'verified_osm', 'probable')) AS ok_loc,
       (s.merge_suspect_score < 2) AS ok_merge,
       (s.facility_trust >= 60) AS ok_trust,
       get(c.snippets, 0).text AS quote,
       regexp_extract(get(c.cite_urls, 0).url, 'https?://([^/]+)', 1) AS source_site,
       CASE WHEN get(c.cite_urls, 0).names_facility_in_url THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS source_names_facility
FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims c JOIN workspace.facility_finder.facilities_serving s ON c.facility_id = s.facility_id
),
r AS (
  SELECT *, CAST(0.4 * claim_strength AS DOUBLE) AS pts_claim, CAST(0.4 * facility_trust / 100.0 AS DOUBLE) AS pts_trust,
         CAST(0.2 * coalesce(location_trust_score, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS pts_loc, CAST(-0.1 * merge_suspect_score AS DOUBLE) AS pts_merge,
         0.4 * claim_strength + 0.4 * facility_trust / 100.0 + 0.2 * coalesce(location_trust_score, 0) - 0.1 * merge_suspect_score AS evidence_score
  FROM b WHERE ok_claim AND ok_loc AND ok_merge AND ok_trust
),
ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY service, state ORDER BY evidence_score DESC) AS rn FROM r)
SELECT service, state, rn AS rank, name, city, level, round(evidence_score, 2) AS evidence_score, facility_trust, location_label,
        quote, source_site, source_names_facility FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10

datasets.name: ds_break
queryLines:
WITH b AS (
SELECT c.service, s.facility_id, s.name, s.city, s.state, s.district, s.lat, s.lon, c.level, c.claim_strength,
       s.location_trust, s.location_trust_score, s.merge_suspect_score, s.facility_trust,
       CASE s.location_trust WHEN 'verified' THEN 'Verified on the map' WHEN 'verified_osm' THEN 'Verified (OpenStreetMap)'
            WHEN 'probable' THEN 'Probable' WHEN 'approximate_pin' THEN 'Only the PIN-code centre' ELSE 'Unverified' END AS location_label,
       (c.level IN ('Strong', 'Moderate')) AS ok_claim,
       (s.location_trust IN ('verified', 'verified_osm', 'probable')) AS ok_loc,
       (s.merge_suspect_score < 2) AS ok_merge,
       (s.facility_trust >= 60) AS ok_trust,
       get(c.snippets, 0).text AS quote,
       regexp_extract(get(c.cite_urls, 0).url, 'https?://([^/]+)', 1) AS source_site,
       CASE WHEN get(c.cite_urls, 0).names_facility_in_url THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS source_names_facility
FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims c JOIN workspace.facility_finder.facilities_serving s ON c.facility_id = s.facility_id
),
r AS (
  SELECT *, CAST(0.4 * claim_strength AS DOUBLE) AS pts_claim, CAST(0.4 * facility_trust / 100.0 AS DOUBLE) AS pts_trust,
         CAST(0.2 * coalesce(location_trust_score, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS pts_loc, CAST(-0.1 * merge_suspect_score AS DOUBLE) AS pts_merge,
         0.4 * claim_strength + 0.4 * facility_trust / 100.0 + 0.2 * coalesce(location_trust_score, 0) - 0.1 * merge_suspect_score AS evidence_score
  FROM b WHERE ok_claim AND ok_loc AND ok_merge AND ok_trust
),
ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY service, state ORDER BY evidence_score DESC) AS rn FROM r)
SELECT service, state, concat(rn, '. ', name) AS facility, stack(4, 'Claim strength', pts_claim, 'Facility trust', pts_trust,
        'Location trust', pts_loc, 'Merge-suspect penalty', pts_merge) AS (component, points) FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5

datasets.name: ds_audit
queryLines:
SELECT level, 'Quote supports the claim' AS verdict, share_yes AS share, audited FROM workspace.facility_finder.claim_audit_summary
      UNION ALL SELECT level, 'Quote does not support it', share_no, audited FROM workspace.facility_finder.claim_audit_summary
      UNION ALL SELECT level, 'Unclear', share_unclear, audited FROM workspace.facility_finder.claim_audit_summary

datasets.name: ds_domains
queryLines:
SELECT least(n_independent_domains, 6) AS independent_sources, round(avg(facility_trust), 1) AS avg_trust, count(*) AS facilities
      FROM workspace.facility_finder.v_eda_trust WHERE n_independent_domains IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

datasets.name: ds_levelmerge
queryLines:
SELECT level, CASE WHEN facility_merge_suspect THEN 'on a record that may mix facilities' ELSE 'on a clean record' END AS kind, count(*) AS n
      FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_signals
queryLines:
SELECT * FROM VALUES
        (1, 'Evidence level: Strong', 'starts at 72%', 'The facility text names the service in several fields'),
        (2, 'Evidence level: Moderate', 'starts at 50%', 'One field names it'),
        (3, 'Evidence level: Weak', 'starts at 20%', 'A passing mention only'),
        (4, 'Another field agrees', 'up', 'Each extra field that agrees, up to three'),
        (5, 'Prerequisite missing (e.g. NICU with no neonatologist)', 'down, strongly', 'Claim is implausible without it'),
        (6, 'Text contradicts the claim', 'down, strongly', 'Each contradiction, up to two'),
        (7, 'Record may mix several hospitals', 'down', 'Each red flag lowers the whole record'),
        (8, 'Source page names the facility', 'up', 'A page about this hospital, not another'),
        (9, 'Verified match on the national PM-JAY list', 'up (capped)', 'Independent proof the hospital exists; cannot rescue weak evidence')
      AS t(step, signal, effect, why)

datasets.name: ds_eval
queryLines:
SELECT test, passed, total, passed / total AS pass_rate FROM (SELECT * FROM VALUES
        ('Real emergencies recognised', 22, 22), ('Non-emergencies left alone (no false alarm)', 11, 11), ('Recommendation test queries passed', 11, 12)
      AS t(test, passed, total))

datasets.name: ds_desert
queryLines:
SELECT service, CASE WHEN km <= 10 THEN '1 within 10 km' WHEN km <= 25 THEN '2 10 to 25 km' WHEN km <= 50 THEN '3 25 to 50 km'
        WHEN km <= 100 THEN '4 50 to 100 km' ELSE '5 over 100 km' END AS bucket, count(*) AS n FROM workspace.facility_finder.eda_office_service_km GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_thin
queryLines: SELECT state, count(*) AS facilities FROM workspace.facility_finder.facilities_serving WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_items
queryLines:
SELECT * FROM VALUES ('Not about services (addresses, hours, history)', 33860), ('Non-medical (wheelchair access, parking)', 3716),
        ('Described a different hospital', 3282), ('Repeats within the same list', 3058), ('Empty placeholders ("none", "-")', 1006) AS t(reason, items)

datasets.name: ds_rules
queryLines:
SELECT * FROM VALUES
        (1, 'Booking or directory sites only', 'Claims capped at Weak', '965 claims lowered (1,818 hospitals appear only on such sites)'),
        (2, 'Facility type or missing support clashes with the claim', 'Marked Contradicted', '369 claims (e.g. a clinic listing an ICU)'),
        (3, 'Record may contain another hospital', 'Marked "confirm first"', '2,264 claims on 445 hospitals'),
        (4, 'C-section not stated, but obstetrics + operating theatre + anaesthesia listed', 'Marked Inferred', '339 hospitals'),
        (5, 'Item list stops at exactly 50', 'A missing service may be missing data', '3,226 hospitals (32%)'),
        (6, 'No service evidence at all', 'Shown as Unknown, never as "offers nothing"', '3,263 hospitals')
      AS t(step, situation, what_we_do, how_many)

datasets.name: ds_reg_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT sum(CASE WHEN tier = 'verified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verified, sum(CASE WHEN tier = 'possible' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS possible,
        sum(CASE WHEN badge_eligible THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_eligible, (SELECT count(*) FROM workspace.facility_finder.hem_hospitals) AS national_list FROM workspace.facility_finder.registry_match

datasets.name: ds_reg_method
queryLines:
SELECT CASE method WHEN 'name+place' THEN 'Name and place agree' WHEN 'phone+name' THEN 'Phone and name agree' WHEN 'weak' THEN 'Weak: needs a person to check'
        ELSE 'Agrees, but phone is shared' END AS how_matched, CASE tier WHEN 'verified' THEN 'Verified' ELSE 'Possible (not used as proof)' END AS outcome, count(*) AS n
      FROM workspace.facility_finder.registry_match GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_reg_km
queryLines:
SELECT CASE WHEN km <= 1 THEN '1 within 1 km' WHEN km <= 5 THEN '2 1 to 5 km' WHEN km <= 25 THEN '3 5 to 25 km' ELSE '4 over 25 km' END AS distance, count(*) AS n
      FROM workspace.facility_finder.registry_match WHERE tier = 'verified' AND km IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

datasets.name: ds_reg_owner
queryLines:
SELECT 'National list (39,737)' AS source, ownership, count(*) AS n FROM workspace.facility_finder.hem_hospitals GROUP BY 2
      UNION ALL SELECT 'Verified matches in our data', ownership, count(*) FROM workspace.facility_finder.registry_match WHERE tier = 'verified' GROUP BY 2

datasets.name: ds_reg_signals
queryLines:
SELECT * FROM VALUES
        (1, 'Verified match on the national list', '+0.5', 'Independent proof the hospital exists'),
        (2, 'The list names a specialty package that maps to this service', '+0.8', 'Independent evidence for the service itself'),
        (3, 'NABH accredited / trauma-burn unit on the list', '+0.15', 'Extra recognition'),
        (4, 'All registry evidence together', 'capped at +1.2', 'It can never turn Weak evidence into a recommendation')
      AS t(step, signal, effect, why)

datasets.name: ds_addr
queryLines:
SELECT concat('1 Address check: ', address_check) AS address_verdict,
        concat('2 Final location: ', CASE location_trust WHEN 'verified' THEN 'verified on the map' WHEN 'verified_osm' THEN 'verified by OpenStreetMap' WHEN 'probable' THEN 'probable'
          WHEN 'approximate_pin' THEN 'PIN-code centre only' WHEN 'approximate_district' THEN 'district centre only' ELSE 'unverified' END) AS final_location, count(*) AS n
      FROM workspace.facility_finder.fac_final GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_phone_flow
queryLines:
WITH t AS (SELECT sum(n_phone_valid) + sum(n_phone_invalid) AS checked, sum(n_phone_usable) AS usable FROM workspace.facility_finder.fac_final)
      SELECT 'Numbers checked' AS step1, 'Usable' AS step2, 'Kept as the hospital phone' AS step3, usable AS n FROM t
      UNION ALL SELECT 'Numbers checked', 'Set aside', reason, numbers FROM VALUES
        ('Booking or aggregator line', 1175), ('Shared with an unrelated hospital', 1057), ('Landline from the wrong state', 229),
        ('Fake number', 37), ('Invalid or foreign', 60), ('Other', 57) AS r(reason, numbers)

datasets.name: ds_phone_status
queryLines:
SELECT CASE official_phone_status WHEN 'ok' THEN 'Fine' WHEN '' THEN 'None listed' WHEN 'aggregator_line' THEN 'Booking or aggregator line'
        WHEN 'shared_unrelated' THEN 'Shared with an unrelated hospital' WHEN 'chain_helpline' THEN 'Chain helpline' WHEN 'area_code_conflict' THEN 'Area code from another state'
        WHEN 'placeholder' THEN 'Fake number' ELSE 'Foreign number' END AS status, count(*) AS n FROM workspace.facility_finder.fac_final GROUP BY 1

datasets.name: ds_numcheck
queryLines:
SELECT 'Founding year' AS field, CASE WHEN year_check LIKE 'corrected%' OR year_check LIKE 'filled%' THEN '2 Corrected or filled from a source'
          WHEN year_check LIKE 'confirmed%' OR year_check LIKE 'consistent%' OR year_check LIKE 'close to%' THEN '1 Confirmed or consistent'
          WHEN year_check LIKE 'disputed%' OR year_check LIKE 'conflicts%' OR year_check LIKE 'differs%' OR year_check LIKE 'web: contradicted%' THEN '3 Disputed or contradicted'
          WHEN year_check LIKE 'missing%' THEN '5 Missing (never guessed)' ELSE '4 Could not be checked' END AS result, count(*) AS n FROM workspace.facility_finder.fac_final GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'Beds' AS field, CASE WHEN capacity_check LIKE 'corrected%' OR capacity_check LIKE 'filled%' THEN '2 Corrected or filled from a source'
          WHEN capacity_check LIKE 'confirmed%' OR capacity_check LIKE 'consistent%' OR capacity_check LIKE 'close to%' THEN '1 Confirmed or consistent'
          WHEN capacity_check LIKE 'disputed%' OR capacity_check LIKE 'conflicts%' OR capacity_check LIKE 'differs%' OR capacity_check LIKE 'web: contradicted%' THEN '3 Disputed or contradicted'
          WHEN capacity_check LIKE 'missing%' THEN '5 Missing (never guessed)' ELSE '4 Could not be checked' END AS result, count(*) AS n FROM workspace.facility_finder.fac_final GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'Doctors' AS field, CASE WHEN doctors_check LIKE 'corrected%' OR doctors_check LIKE 'filled%' THEN '2 Corrected or filled from a source'
          WHEN doctors_check LIKE 'confirmed%' OR doctors_check LIKE 'consistent%' OR doctors_check LIKE 'close to%' THEN '1 Confirmed or consistent'
          WHEN doctors_check LIKE 'disputed%' OR doctors_check LIKE 'conflicts%' OR doctors_check LIKE 'differs%' OR doctors_check LIKE 'web: contradicted%' THEN '3 Disputed or contradicted'
          WHEN doctors_check LIKE 'missing%' THEN '5 Missing (never guessed)' ELSE '4 Could not be checked' END AS result, count(*) AS n FROM workspace.facility_finder.fac_final GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: ds_tiers
queryLines:
SELECT 'Moderate or stronger evidence' AS tier, count(DISTINCT facility_id) AS hospitals FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims WHERE level IN ('Strong', 'Moderate')
      UNION ALL SELECT 'Only weak or inferred claims', count(DISTINCT facility_id) - (SELECT count(DISTINCT facility_id) FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims WHERE level IN ('Strong', 'Moderate')) FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims
      UNION ALL SELECT 'No usable evidence (shown as Unknown)', count(*) FROM workspace.facility_finder.facilities_serving s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace.facility_finder.facility_claims c WHERE c.facility_id = s.facility_id)

lines:
## 1. The raw records cannot be taken at face value
Most of the data was scraped from web text. A facility *saying* it offers a service is not the same as offering it. So we scored every record on **where it is**, **whether it is really one hospital**, and **how well its claims are evidenced**.

## 3. How do we know the evidence is right?
We checked a sample of claims by asking a language model whether the **quoted text really supports the claim**. Strong claims hold up best: 72% are supported by their own quote and only 6% are not.

lines: ### The national hospital list (HEM / PM-JAY) as an independent witness
It was not scraped from web text, so it can confirm a hospital exists. It adds to a claim's score but is capped, and can never turn weak evidence into a recommendation.

## Reference: how we did it, step by step
Every cleaning step, with the file it came from. The last column says how we got each number: **counted from the data** (when this dashboard was built), from a **report in the repo**, or from the **team summary** (not reproducible from this folder). Use the filters to focus on one stage.
### 1. Read and repair: 10,088 rows become 9,989 facilities

The file's quotes are escaped in a non-standard way, so a normal read crashes. 88 rows were pieces of 30 real records and all 30 were stitched back. 11 identical copies were dropped. Original values are kept in raw_ columns.

lines: ### 2. Where is it? Three independent checks on every location

India Post PIN directory, the facility's own coordinates, and OpenStreetMap. The ribbon below shows how the address check (left) became the final location trust (right). Use the filters to see which checks fire for one state or facility type.

lines: ### 3. Phones: valid, shared, or somebody else's?

Every number was parsed against the Indian numbering plan, then tested for being a shared booking line, a fake, or from the wrong state. The set-aside reasons come from the team summary; the totals are live.
### 4. Numbers and dates: checked against outside sources
Wikidata (285 matched facilities), web searches for every extreme value, and the facility's own text. We never overwrite a value we have not verified, and we never guess a missing one.

Free text was split into items, off-topic items were moved aside, and each service claim got a level, the exact quote, and up to 3 source links that name the hospital.

lines: ### 6. The government registry (HEM): an independent witness

HEM is the National Health Authority's Hospital Empanelment Module list of PM-JAY hospitals. It was not scraped from web text, so it can confirm that a hospital exists and which specialty packages it is approved for. We match by name and place, or phone and name.
